text:
Rachel: Kickoff for SpectralMesh POC. Prospect target: 500 qps sustained for 5m, p95 <= 200ms. They need KMS integration (customer-managed), no persistent logs for PII, and want hosted vs dedicated cost comparison. Please assemble load plan, runbook, and rough pricing.

Julian: I can draft the load plan. Quick confirms: model mix redwood-3b primary, redwood-7b fallback, 80/20? Region us-west2?

Rachel: Correct on both. Prompts variable, avg 64 tokens, peaks to 256. Outputs avg ~128.

Meera: Heads up: hosted can do bursts but maintaining p95 under 200ms at 500 qps consistently usually requires Dedicated with pre-warmed KV and reserved GPUs. We'll need a warmup strategy and KV priming.

Talya: On security, they want KMS key control and HSM options. Also asked about retention windows and export controls. I'll start the questionnaire replies (SOC2, key rotation, access controls).

Eli: I'll work pricing. Need an expected token mix to model hosted per-token vs 3-month dedicated commit estimate. Also include cost uplift for KMS/HSM.

Julian: Proposed load plan: 
- Target: steady 500 qps for 5m; ramp 0->500 over 300s; cool-down 60s.
- Mix: 80% redwood-3b gen, 20% redwood-7b for high-quality/long prompts.
- Payloads: avg in 64, avg out 128, occasional 256 in.
- Warmup: 10k requests with increasing concurrency to populate caches and KV.
- Metrics: p50/p90/p95/p99, tail latency heatmap, GPU util, KV hit rate, memory, token throughput, error rate.
- Fallback: if 7b unavailable route to 3b and tag event.

Load command example: 
```\nwrk -t24 -c900 -d00:06:00 --latency -s scripts/llm_post.lua --rate 500 http://loadgen-proxy/llm\n```

Warmup snippet: `{"model_mix":"3b:80,7b:20","seq_in":64,"seq_out":128,"warmup":10000}` (used as a payload template).

Meera: Infra notes: For deterministic tails at p95<=200ms we recommend Dedicated with ~4 A100-equivalent workers (or equivalent RTX5120 scale) depending on batching. Pre-warm containers and KV. Hosted projected to be ~25% higher p95 on average without dedicated pool. Multi-AZ placement recommended to mirror production networking.

Talya: Questionnaire short answers: KMS: yes, customer-managed keys supported; Key rotation: supported via KMS; HSM: partner integration available for dedicated/private; Logging: default metric/log retention 7 days, can disable request logging for PII paths. I'll attach formal answers.

Eli: Token math: avg tokens per request ~192 (64 in + 128 out). For the 5m steady window: 500 qps * 60s * 5m * 192 tokens = ~28,800,000 tokens; warmup adds ~2M. Use these for cost estimates. I'll produce hosted per-token estimate and a 3-month reserved capacity quote including prewarm.

ops-bot: deploy-bot notice: loadgen/prod-scripts v2.4 -> staging scheduled 2026-03-18T15:02Z :rocket:

Meera: Ops checklist for the run: reserve Dedicated capacity (if opted), prewarm KV with provided script, enable fallback routing flag, collect system metrics at 1s granularity, and store raw traces + aggregated CSVs. Prewarm command: 
```\npython tools/prewarm_kv.py --model redwood-3b --requests 10000 --parallel 64\n```

Rachel: Action items: Julian to run smoke and full run, deliver p95/p99 + util CSV by end of day Friday; Talya to finish and upload questionnaire + KMS appendix; Meera to confirm infra reservation & warmup; Eli to prepare hosted vs 3-month dedicated pricing delta using token estimate. Keep report concise (one slide summary + raw CSVs).

Julian: Ack. I'll run a smoke tonight and the full run tomorrow morning, will include heatmaps and per-model breakdown.

Talya: Ack, uploading questionnaire draft to thread shortly.

Eli: I'll draft two pricing scenarios (hosted burst vs dedicated commit) and include KMS/HSM add-on costs.

Rachel: Thanks team :thumbsup: Marking this thread as the POC perf coordination doc. Please keep notes minimal and attach CSVs and config snippets.
